refreshNotes: 2026 introduces the Trail Boss off-road trim (2-inch lift, 35-inch tires, Terrain drive mode, four-wheel steering). RST is sold only as the Stars & Steel Special Edition. Destination freight raised from $2,095 to $2,595 (Dec 2025) - $500 price uplift across lineup. Three new paint colors. Sources: [GM Newsroom Trail Boss](https://news.chevrolet.com/newsroom.detail.html/Pages/news/us/en/2025/may/0521-Trail-Boss-joins-2026-Chevrolet-Silverado-EV.html), [GM Authority 2026 pricing](https://gmauthority.com/blog/2025/06/here-is-2026-chevy-silverado-ev-pricing-with-options-and-packages/).
